definitions.explanation: A state of harmonious, well-balanced proportions. Most commonly used to describe physical bodies, architecture, and other visual forms that are pleasing due to their balanced proportions.

examples.japanese: {均整|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とれた⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{均整|きんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均整|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とれたフォルム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見入|みい}って→見入る：16142_miiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I found myself gazing at the well-balanced form of the sculpture.

notes:
Composed of {均|きん} (equal, level) + {整|せい} (order, arrangement). Describes the visual harmony that comes from balanced proportions.

USAGE:
{均整|きんせい} is most commonly encountered in the set phrase {均整|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とれた (well-proportioned, well-balanced). It is a literary and descriptive word, used in writing about art, architecture, the human body, and aesthetics. It implies visual balance and harmony rather than mere symmetry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {均整|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とれた: well-proportioned, well-balanced
- {均整|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とれた⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧: well-proportioned figure
- {均整|きんせい}⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧: beauty of proportion
- {均整|きんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain proportion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧: balance — a common loanword used broadly for balance in any domain
- {対称|たいしょう}: symmetry — specifically mirror symmetry, more geometric than {均整|きんせい}
- ⟦{調和|ちょうわ}→調和：05216_chouwa⟧: harmony — broader concept of things fitting together well, not limited to visual proportion
